records.jp: 暇だよ。もしかしてまた遊びの誘い？
records.en_original: Nope. Do you wanna hang out?
records.en_auxiliary: Nope. Do you wanna hang out?
records.en: I'm free. Is this another invitation to play?

records.jp: もち！　今日はサッカーボールとか持ってきたよ
records.en_original: Bingo! I brought a soccer ball with me today.
records.en_auxiliary: Bingo! I brought a soccer ball with me today.
records.en: Of course! I brought a soccer ball and stuff today.

records.jp: また体力使いそうな遊びを……
records.en: Another game that looks like it'll use a lot of stamina...

records.jp: 嫌だった？
records.en: Do you not want to?

records.jp: ううん、望むところ！
records.en: Nah, bring it on!

records.jp: はあ……はあ……
records.en: *Pant* *pant*

records.jp: 勇希、バテてきたんじゃない？<CR>そろそろ休憩にする？
records.en_original: How are you feeling? Wanna take a break?
records.en_auxiliary: How are you feeling? Wanna take a break?
records.en: Yuki, aren't you starting to wear out?<CR>Should we take a break soon?

records.jp: いや、まだまだへーき……！<CR>……おりゃ！
records.en_original: No way, I feel great! Watch this!
records.en_auxiliary: No way, I feel great! Watch this!
records.en: No, I'm still fiiine...!<CR>...Take that!

records.jp: あー、もう！　どこ蹴ってんのー！
records.en: Whoa! Watch where you're kicking!

records.jp: ご、ごめーん……！
records.en: S-sorry!

records.jp: 勇希ー、ボール見つかんないよー
records.en_original: Yuki, I can't find the ball!
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki, I can't find the ball!
records.en: Yuki, I can't find the ball!

records.jp: 勇希！？
records.en: Yuki?!

records.jp: ……うっ、ぐ
records.en: Ngh... Ugh...

records.jp: 勇希！　大丈夫！？　勇希！！
records.en: Yuki! Are you okay?! Yuki!

records.jp: ……落ち着いた？　水飲む？
records.en_original: Are you feeling better? Want some water?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you feeling better? Want some water?
records.en: Are you feeling better? Want some water?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ごめん……。心配かけて
records.en: Sorry for worrying you...

records.jp: ホントだよ、もう……
records.en: You really did...

records.jp: 何事も全力なのはいいけど、倒れちゃったら意味ないよ
records.en_original: I know I said I admire you giving everything your all, but there's no reason to exhaust yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: I know I said I admire you giving everything your all, but there's no reason to exhaust yourself.
records.en: It's good to give everything your all, but it's meaningless if you collapse.

records.jp: 意味なくなんかない！
records.en: It isn't meaningless!
Huh...?

records.jp: あ、ごめん……。大きな声出して
records.en_original: O-oh, sorry... I didn't mean to yell.
records.en_auxiliary: O-oh, sorry... I didn't mean to yell.
records.en: O-oh, sorry... I didn't mean to yell.

records.jp: あたしがいろいろ全力なのは、<CR>自分でもなんでかよくわかってなかったけど……
records.en_original: I don't really know why I'm like this either, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't really know why I'm like this either, but...
records.en: I didn't really understand myself<CR>why I gave everything my all, but...

records.jp: ……ほら、あたしが病気だったって話、あったじゃん
records.en_original: You know that whole thing about how I was sick?
records.en_auxiliary: You know that whole thing about how I was sick?
records.en: You know that whole thing about how I was sick?

records.jp: うん……
records.en: Yeah...?

records.jp: もしかしたら、あたしにはあまり時間が<CR>残されてないのかも……
records.en_original: It's just... I might not have much time left.
records.en_auxiliary: It's just... I might not have much time left.
records.en: Maybe I don't have much time<CR>left...

records.jp: 心のどこかにそんな気持ちがきっとあってさ。<CR>今を全力で楽しまなきゃ後悔するって感じたんだと思う
records.en_original: I think it's always been at the back of my mind that if I don't enjoy myself to the fullest extent now, I might regret it.
records.en_auxiliary: I think it's always been at the back of my mind that if I don't enjoy myself to the fullest extent now, I might regret it.
records.en: I'm sure that feeling was somewhere in my heart.<CR>I think I felt I'd regret it if I didn't enjoy the present with all I had.

records.jp: それが、勇希がいつも全力な理由……
records.en: So that's why Yuki always gives everything her all...

records.jp: ま、そういうこと
records.en: Yeah, that's about it.

records.jp: 心配かけてごめん。<CR>でも、気は遣わなくていいから
records.en_original: Sorry again. But you don't need to worry about me.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry again. But you don't need to worry about me.
records.en: Sorry for worrying you.<CR>But you don't need to treat me differently.

records.jp: 明日もまた、全力で遊ぼう！
records.en_original: I'm gonna make sure I enjoy tomorrow to the fullest!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm gonna make sure I enjoy tomorrow to the fullest!
records.en: Let's play with all we've got again tomorrow!

records.jp: 交流により新たな工作物を思いつきました。<CR>「<CLGR>激臭ガス爆弾<CLNR>」のメモリーを手に入れました
records.en_original: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Stink Bomb<CLNR> memory.
records.en_auxiliary: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Stink Bomb<CLNR> memory.
records.en: A new crafting idea came to you through your bond.<CR>You obtained the <CLGR>Stink Bomb<CLNR> memory.
